spans.s: The words बहु 'many' , गण 'class' and the words ending in the affix वतु -- यद्तदेतेभ्यः परिमाणे वतुप्‌
and डति -- किमः संख्यापरिमाणे डति च

are called numerals (संख्या).

Terms: संख्या

In expressing multeity, a Plural case affix is employed.

Terms: छन्दस्

In the छन्दस् (Vedas), घसॢ is diversely substituted for अद्।

Terms: छन्दस्
In the छन्दस् (Vedas) there is diversely the लुक् elision of the विकरण शप् -- कर्तरि शप्‌

.

Terms: शप्‌-elision-छन्दस्

In the छन्दस् (Vedas) there is elision of the शप् diversely.

Terms: शप्‌-elision

In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the affix क्विप्‌ diversely comes after the verb हन् 'to kill' with the sense of past time,ending with the word even when the word in composition with it is other than those mentioned in the last sūtra.

Terms: क्विप्‌

In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the affix विनि is added diversely in the sense of मतुप् ।

Terms: छन्दस्-विनि

In the छन्दस् , the semi-vowel of this root is diversely vocalised.

Terms: लिट् लकार

The augment रुट् is diversely applied in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

Terms: Some substitution

In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the substitution takes place diversely.

Terms: Some substitution

In the छन्दस् (Vedas), the उर् substitution for ॠ of a root-stem is diverse.

Terms: उ substitution

In the छन्दस् (Vedas), a single consonantal सार्वधातुक affix gets diversely the augment after अस् (अस्ति) and after the Aorist character सिच् ।

Terms: ईट् augment

इ is diversely substituted in the छन्दस् (Vedas) for the vowel of the reduplicate, in the Reduplicated Present-form.

Terms: Reduplicate
And there is लुक् elision of the गोत्र affix इञ् -- गोत्राद्यून्यस्त्रियाम्

after a word containing many vowels (a poly-syllabic word) which denotes the गोत्र of the people called प्राच्य and भरत when the word takes the plural.

Terms: गोत्र-elision

The affix णिनि comes after a verb diversely when continued repitition of an action is to be expressed.

Terms: णिनि

The affix ङीप् is used in the feminine after a बहुव्रीहि समास ending in the word ऊधस् 'an udder'.

Terms: विभक्ति-ङीप्

And the affix ङीष् is optionally used in the feminine after the words बहु etc.

Terms: विभक्ति-ङीष्

The affix इञ् is added in the sense of a descendant after the words बहु etc.

Terms: इञ्

The affix ङीष् is used in the feminine after that बहुव्रीहि समास which ending with a word formed by the affix क्त has an acute accent on the last syllable.

Terms: विभक्ति-ङीष्

The feminine affix ऊङ् comes in denoting a Name after a प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) ending with the word बाहु।

Terms: विभक्ति-ऊङ्

The affix अञ् comes in the quadruple sense after a polysyllabic प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) when 'a well' is to be designated.

Terms: चातुर्थिक-अञ्

The affix ठञ् comes in the sense of 'staying' and 'a commentary' after a polysyllabic word having उदात्त on the final (the word being the name of a thing to be explained).

Terms: ठञ्

The affix ठच् comes in the sense of 'this is whose act occurring in study' after a compound having polysyllabic word as a prior member.

Terms: ठच्

When डट् follows, तिथुक् is the augment of the words 1. बहु 2. पूग 3. गण and 4. सङ्गघ।

Terms: डट् and (तिथुक्)

The affix ठच् is optionally added to a word of more than two syllables being the name of a human being, as an expression of compassion or of courtesy joined with compassion.

Terms: ठच्

After a word signifying much or little, comes the affix शस् optionally when the word stands in agreement with a verb (as कारक)।

Terms: शस्

The affix डाच् comes after a बहुव्रीहि समास denoting numeral except when the last term of such समास is बहु and गण।

Terms: डाच्

The affix षच् comes after the words 1. सक्थि and 2. अक्षि , final in a बहुव्रीहि समास and denoting a portion of one's body.

Terms: षच्

The form बहुप्रजास् is valid in the Vedas.

Terms: छन्दस्

In a बहुव्रीहि समास the first member preserves its own original accent.

Terms: बहुव्रीहि समास

In a द्विगु समास (Numeral Determinative Compound) the word बहु may optionally preserve its accent when followed by an इक्-ending stem or by a time-word or by 1. कपाल 2. भगाल and 3. शराव।

Terms: द्विगु समास

The word विश्व has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final, being first member in a बहुव्रीहि समास , when it is a Name.

Terms: समास end acute-1st-term

In a बहुव्रीहि समास , after the words इदम् , एतद् and तद् the last syllable of प्रथम and of a proper ordinal numeral as the acute accent (उदात्त) when the number of times of an action is meant.

Terms: समास end acute-2nd-term

A बहुव्रीहि समास with बहु has the same accent as नञ् when it denotes muchness of the object expressed by the second member.

Terms: समास end acute-2nd-term

There is diversity in the छन्दस् (Vedas) : the augment अट् or आट् is added even with मा and sometimes not added even there is no मा।

Terms: अ augment

The इ and ई of these affixes (इमन् and ईयस्) are elided after बहु , and for बहु is substituted भू।

Terms: Some substitution

Before a case-ending beginning with भ् or स् (literally a consonant of the झल् प्रत्यहार) in the plural, ए is substituted for the final अ of Nominal-stem.

Terms: Lengthening

For (the Genitive 6th-Case, Dative -4th Case and Accusative -2nd case) plural of युष्मद् and अस्मद् are substituted वस् and नस् respectively (when a word precedes and these substitutes are अनुदात्त).

Terms: सर्वनाम
